text:
maya: quick handoff — i packaged the staging candidate and a golden-playbook for QA. weights are at s3://redwood-models/releases/candidate-2026-04/model-x/weights.pt and tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/releases/candidate-2026-04/tokenizer/ (see README in the folder).

ajay: ack, grabbing weights now. i’ll run the config validator and smoke generation. can you paste the exact model config used for serving?

maya: config snippet below (copy from release):
```
model_name: model-x
max_sequence_length: 4096
precision: int8
kv_cache: enabled
autoscale_policy: "latency-slo-95=200ms"
allowed_tool_callers: ["search", "calculator"]
```

sophia: heads up — tokenizer had a weird split on zero-width spaces in a few golden prompts (\u200b). i normalized them in the goldset but keeping a note: some samples tokenized 1 extra token which shifts offsets for structured outputs.

zach: CI validator flagged "max_sequence_length: 4096" vs model metadata which reports "context_size: 8192" — that mismatch caused a warning but not a block. also saw a quantization flag mismatch in the serve profile (int8 vs int4); double-checking perf tradeoffs.

maya: good catch. the model was trained with 8k context, but our staging runtime currently uses 4k default to keep mem low. plan: enable dynamic padding and kv_cache to reuse earlier tokens — ajay can we try a small run with context_override=8192?

ajay: will try. quick smoke command for others to reproduce locally:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"model-x","input":"{{golden_prompt}}","max_tokens":256,"output_format":"json_schema"}'
```

ci-bot: regression-suite/model-x: started run 1965432701 — running 24 golden prompts + 8 tool-call scenarios.

ci-bot: regression-suite/model-x: results: 20/24 golden prompts passed, 3/8 tool-calls failed (search tool schema mismatch), 1/24 golden had structured-output schema violation (offset mismatch). full report: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/1965432701

eva: can you paste the failing JSON schema example? we should standardize on the minimal schema to avoid brittle offsets.

maya: failing schema example (one-line):
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string"},"entities":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"label":{"type":"string"},"start":{"type":"integer"},"end":{"type":"integer"}}}}},"required":["intent"]}
```

ajay: looks fine. the offset break is likely from sophia's zero-width char note. i'll re-run tokenization with normalization and re-run the three failing tool-calls.

sophia: i've pushed a tokenizer patch that strips zero-widths and collapses repeated whitespace by default for these gold prompts — PR: https://git.internal/redwood/tokenizers/pulls/142. still reviewable.

zach: small ops note — please add a serve-profile label "candidate-2026-04" to the instance so we can route traffic properly during canary. also we should pin fallback policy: fallback_model: model-x-v1 if tool-call schema mismatch.

maya: agreed on both. last ask: eva, can you own the golden-playbook doc review? it's in the repo at docs/golden-playbooks/model-x.md — it contains the prompt list, expected structured output schema, and the tool-call mock responses. aim to sign off by EOD. :pray:

eva: i'll take it. i'll triage the three failing tool-calls and return a short checklist: 1) tokenizer normalization applied, 2) re-run regression suite, 3) confirm serve-profile labels and fallback policy.

ajay: re-run results (later): normalized tokenizer fixed the schema violation. tool-call failures reduced from 3 -> 1 (search schema still failing due to arg name "query_text" vs expected "q"). raising PR to adapt search shim.

maya: nice. once search shim PR lands, let's re-run and if green, schedule a canary for midnight PST.

ci-bot: regression-suite/model-x: run 1965435120 — final: 24/24 golden prompts passed, 8/8 tool-call scenarios passed. mark: READY_FOR_CANARY.

eva: marking checklist done, will update docs and post a short summary in #eng-release when canary schedule is set.

maya: thanks everyone — main artifacts: weights path, tokenizer patch PR link, serve config snippet, golden-playbook doc. ping me if you need the sample prompts or I can export the goldset as JSONL. :rocket:
